summary: Iteration 9 fully validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 16/16 pass. Match date+status: POST /clubs/{id}/announcements with match_date sets status=upcoming/ongoing/past based on 2h window and returns undated when omitted; status also present in GET /clubs/{id}/announcements and /matches/history. Replay: POST /api/announcements/{id}/replay creates a new match in the same club with the same registered players + copied offline_names, sends a private DM to each co-player (verified via unread_count increment and GET /messages/{marc} contains 'rejouer' invite from marc). Favorites: POST /users/{id}/favorite toggles ({is_favorite:true/false}), GET /users/favorites returns enriched list, get_user returns viewer-specific is_favorite, self-favoriting returns 400, route /users/favorites is declared before /users/{id} (routing verified). Frontend: club composer exposes MatchDatePicker (compose-day-<i> + compose-hour-<h>) — post creates a card with date pill + 'À venir' status tag. /matches screen has 3 segmented tabs (group-upcoming/ongoing/past) with live counts; each card exposes replay-<id> that opens a modal with MatchDatePicker (replay-day-<i>/replay-hour-<h>) + replay-confirm — confirming creates the match and the 'À venir' tab count increments. Player profile shows favorite-btn (heart) that toggles favorite state (turns red when favorited), reliability card labeled 'Fiabilité' with criteria text 'Ponctualité · sympathie · pas d'annulation de dernière minute · participe au règlement du terrain' and 'Noter la fiabilité' explicitly clarifies '… — pas le niveau de jeu.'. Profile screen exposes favorites-btn -> /favorites showing fav-<id> rows that open the player profile. Regression OK: join/leave, historique 4/4, composer offline_names chips, blur/lock non-abonné intact. Only cosmetic 'shadow*' RN Web warnings remain.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow). Cosmetic on web preview, non-blocking on native. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create blocks.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN Web warnings (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:225-240 match_status handles Z-suffix ISO, missing tzinfo, and 2h ongoing window correctly; returns 'undated' on parse failure (safe fallback).
server.py:302-310 /users/favorites is declared BEFORE /users/{user_id} — route ordering verified live; a GET on /users/favorites returns a list, not a 404 from the {id} handler.
server.py:319-334 toggle_favorite: rejects self (400), 404 on unknown target, atomic $set of favorites list; response shape {is_favorite: bool}.

server.py:501-545 replay copies src.players + src.offline_names into a new announcement authored by the caller, and inserts a private DM (with correct conv_id) for each other registered player — verified via unread_count delta.
server.py:207-223 user_public now takes optional viewer and adds is_favorite bool — used consistently in get_user, rate_user, list_favorites and serialize_announcement.players[].

matches.tsx exposes group-upcoming/ongoing/past, replay-<id>, replay-day/hour/confirm/close; club/[id].tsx composer uses MatchDatePicker with compose-day/hour prefix; player/[id].tsx has favorite-btn heart + reliability criteria text incl. 'pas le niveau de jeu'; profile.tsx has favorites-btn -> /favorites listing fav-<id> rows.
